# Transformations123

> Transformations123 is the executive career practice of Amy Sindicic, BCC, MSEd, MIM. It helps government leaders, SES candidates, military leaders, and corporate executives translate their experience into private-sector executive value through resume writing, LinkedIn personal branding, interview preparation, and career strategy.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://transformations123.com/): Executive career strategy, positioning, and resume writing for senior leaders.
- [About Amy](https://transformations123.com/about): Background and approach of Amy Sindicic, Board-Certified Career Coach and executive resume writer.
- [Services](https://transformations123.com/services): Executive resume writing, LinkedIn branding, interview preparation, and career strategy.
- [Book a discovery call](https://transformations123.com/book): Schedule a complimentary consultation.

## For each audience

- [Government leaders](https://transformations123.com/government): Translating public-sector leadership into private-sector value.
- [SES candidates](https://transformations123.com/ses): Senior Executive Service applications, ECQs, and SES resumes.
- [Military leaders](https://transformations123.com/military): Military-to-civilian executive transitions.
- [Corporate executives](https://transformations123.com/corporate): Positioning for the next level of corporate leadership.
